follow_up_findings.finding: agent-system/extensions/core/context/reference/team-wave-helpers.md (400 lines) is referenced ONLY by the three deleted team skills (grep -rln team-wave-helpers) plus its own index-entries.json entry. It contains one 'skill-team-*' glob reference (not one of the three literal names, so it does not trip the Phase 8 zero-hits grep or appear in the file_scope inventory). After this task's deletion, it becomes an orphaned reference-pattern document with no consumer.
follow_up_findings.reason_out_of_scope: Not in the plan's 19-file inventory (missed because it uses a glob pattern, not the three literal skill names, and the plan's grep for scope-confirmation used the literal names only), not in the broadened file_scope, and not required by the literal zero-hits acceptance criterion. Deleting or rewriting it would exceed this task's carefully-scoped file_scope and risk an unreviewed edit outside the batch's admission-gate serialization guarantee.
follow_up_findings.recommendation: A small follow-up task should either delete team-wave-helpers.md or repurpose it as general (non-team-specific) wave-coordination reference material, and remove its index-entries.json entry if deleted.
